THE FORECASTING RULE, binding from now on. Full text in
docs/plan/REPLAN-2026-08-12.md section 2.

1. Estimate from MEASURED throughput, never imagined effort. Quote a previous
   run's actual duration. With no measurement, say so and make the lower bound
   a quarter of the instinctive guess.
2. Ranges with their assumption, never points, naming what makes it the slow
   end.
3. EVERY OVERNIGHT PLAN CARRIES AT LEAST 3x MORE QUEUED WORK THAN ITS FORECAST
   NEEDS. Depth is the deliverable. Running out of queue is a planning defect
   and is reported as one.
4. The queue is strictly ordered, every item independently startable, and NO
   item may block on a founder answer because he is asleep. Anything that does
   goes to the founder-gated list, never into the queue.
5. Record actual against forecast at EVERY closed loop. Without it the same
   error repeats forever.
6. Every sprint plan carries its own overflow queue, chosen in advance, for
   the same reason.

PO-8 the tag comes BEFORE the battery; one install assertion cannot pass until
